resources.string: I\'m made of sound, so I wiggle when things get loud. I\'ll show you around MuzViz: a player, a visualizer that dances to your music, and a studio that turns it into video.
Swipe or tap Next. Skip a chapter you know, or skip the lot. Tap Show me to jump to the real thing; I\'ll wait with a Resume button. Every chapter lives on in Settings › Tutorials.
The Player has your track, the transport and a live spectrum. Tap the artwork to go full screen, which is where the visuals live.
Open the queue to reorder what\'s next or save it as a playlist. Drop an .lrc file beside a track and its lyrics follow along, line by line.
The quick row holds a sleep timer, shuffle all and an A–B loop. Switch the source to the mic or to another app\'s audio and the visuals react to that instead.
Look, Audio, Folders and Behavior hold the rest, including reduced motion and visual safety. Backup saves your presets and settings to a file.
That\'s the tour. Replay any chapter in Settings › Tutorials. Now play something loud and watch me go.
Progress cleared. The tour greets you next launch.
